=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitc writes the single byte c
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 c
emit b
end
note each step appends the bitwise complement of the sequence so far; 7 steps reach 64 terms
fn main to int
t = new uchar 64 0
n = ulong 1
for s ulong 7
for i ulong n
emitc add get t i uchar 48
end
emit nl
if lt n 64
for i ulong n
put t add n i sub uchar 1 get t i
end
n = mul n 2
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}

0
01
0110
01101001

0110100110010110100101100110100110010110011010010110100110010110
